time_basis: source frame index / nominal fps, not recorded HUD timestamp
interpretation: High motion confidence refers to observed sustained track traversal. Robot walking remains an inference from onboard bob and passage of landmarks; neither vx HUD nor frame difference proves physical gait.

segments.evidence: Dark/occluded first frames; large rotations, people/robot hardware visible; no reliable sustained track traversal.
Triangle and both boundaries remain almost stationary; repeated source frames.
View pitches/rotates; triangle changes projected position. Insufficient evidence to call walking.
Triangle, boundary and background shoes remain stationary although HUD starts vx before visible travel.
Triangle passes below field, curve and measured track markings traverse continuously with camera bob; square approaches around51-54s.
Decoded frames543-558 are exactly identical including HUD; does not prove robot stopped.
Square exits, boundaries curve and circle approaches. Retain58.4-60.4 and67-68.8s loss/reacquisition stress, not only good frames.
Circle held at similar position while camera pitches down/up and old HUD changes STOP/TRACK; no robust translation.
Boundary/background/circle remain nearly stationary until resumed motion around79.6s.
Circle passes downward out of view; curve and background shift continuously; retain82.6-83.8s LINE LOST.
View swings upward toward wall as HUD stops; useful failure/transition, walking evidence limited.
Wall, rack and outer boundary fixed; minor flicker and tiny shakes only.
View pans down from wall to track; motion alone insufficient to establish walking.
Track ticks, cable and white obstacle move through view; human shoe near109s adds occlusion stress.
Legs/feet occlude view and view pitches toward track; retains LINE LOST transition.
Square approaches continuously between boundaries, visible ink at113-116s; LINE LOST at115s despite visible track.
View tilts toward sideline then human legs dominate; uncertain actual gait.
Frames1178-1212 exactly identical including nonzero vx and HUD t117.76s; cannot be motion ground truth.
Square moves below image while shoes occupy both sides; useful ink/occlusion example, possible robot travel but cannot exclude handling.
Large shakes and panning near people and sideline; no clean sustained lane-following evidence.

ground_truth_limit: Video visibly contains triangle-like, circle-like and square-like cards. It does not establish all six card classes or annotated success rates.
